CROWCOON
CR 1

An odd squealing caw emanates from the creature soaring down. The top half is a raven, and the back half is a raccoon. It alights on a branch and watches with a keen eye.

XP 200
N Tiny magical beast
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +3

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 16 (3d10)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., burrow 10 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)
Melee bite +6 (1d3-1) and 2 talons +6 (1d3-1)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 11, Int 5, Wis 16, Cha 5
Base Attack +3; CMB +0; CMD 12 (16 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Sleight of Hand), Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +11, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +12; Racial Modifiers +3 Sleight of Hands is a class skill
Languages one language commonly used near their natural territory.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary, pair, murder (3-12)
Treasure none

The crowcoon, is an odd amalgam creature. It is highly intelligent for an animalistic creature and it can even speak the languages near them. They are also notorious for stealing shiny baubles that they ferret away in their nests. Some people have trained these creatures to aid in their own thievery.
